info.name: Flutter E-Commerce API
info.description:
Complete API Collection for Flutter E-Commerce Application backed by Laravel REST API.

Base URL: `https://e-commers-laravel.vercel.app/api`

### Features:
- Fully documented requests with realistic request bodies
- Full **Example Responses** (200 OK, 201 Created, 422 Validation Error) for every endpoint
- Automated Test Scripts to capture and persist Bearer Tokens in `{{token}}`
- Pre-configured dynamic environment variables

variable.description: Base URL of the Laravel backend API
Bearer token automatically populated after login/register
Product slug for product detail, reviews, and suggestions
Order ID for order details, status, and receipt
Product ID for wishlist and cart operations
